g.text: turning shipping docs and customs chaos into order
loose wires, blinking LEDs, and just one more compile
Hungary, GMT+2, awake at hours I will not defend
dry, mildly dark, still safe to show your boss
sci-fi, the bleaker the ending the better
» radio, when it is radio's turn
a penguin distro with very strong opinions
a laptop that swears the fan noise is normal
enough cores to compile hope in parallel
renders waveforms far more often than frags
permanently four browser tabs from disaster
the one with the fish, obviously
modal, and I will not be elaborating
since the last update I was brave enough to run
coffee, then tea, then quiet panic
